q_e4df653652.explanation: Crews are directed not to give naloxone in flight unless the patient has cardiovascular collapse from narcotics, which is rare; an abrupt reversal in a confined cabin is more dangerous than continued support of ventilation.

q_001b1bd23e.explanation: Organophosphates inhibit plasma cholinesterase, so succinylcholine's action is markedly prolonged. Rocuronium is directed instead when RSI is required.

q_2230646dc5.explanation: A paralytic stops the convulsion but not the seizure, so sedation must outlast the paralysis. The Seizures guideline prefers avoiding long-acting blockers entirely because they mask ongoing seizure activity.

q_aef01b7b82.stem: A child who has been seizing is febrile. What acetaminophen dose is given?
q_aef01b7b82.explanation: Fever lowers the seizure threshold in children, so acetaminophen 15 mg/kg IV over 15 minutes is given to a maximum of 750 mg. The 50 mg/kg figure is levetiracetam.

q_b3f70dd8b5.explanation: Dopamine starts at 5 mcg/kg/min and is titrated to a maximum of 20 mcg/kg/min, but in septic shock it is restricted to highly selective patients with bradycardia because of its arrhythmogenic profile.

q_ad51964945.explanation: General OB care sets supplemental oxygen to hold the saturation above 92%; the Delivery Complications guideline uses a 94% to 99% target during an active delivery complication.

q_13c5be9485.stem: With ongoing post-partum hemorrhage, what blood loss volume prompts consideration of immediate blood transfusion?
q_13c5be9485.explanation: In post-partum hemorrhage, immediate transfusion is tied to ongoing hemorrhage with blood loss of 1,500 mL or more, or to any woman with tachycardia and hypotension — the vital-sign trigger matters because measured loss is almost always underestimated.

q_e7b17b7cfb.stem: Palpation of the fundus in a post-partum hemorrhage patient finds the uterus boggy rather than firm. What is the most likely etiology of the bleeding?
q_e7b17b7cfb.explanation: In post-partum hemorrhage the crew palpates the fundus for firmness or bogginess and its relation to the umbilicus; a boggy uterus makes atony the most likely source, which is why fundal massage and oxytocin follow immediately.

q_f718756e86.stem: In post-partum hemorrhage after the placenta has been delivered, how much oxytocin is added to 1000 mL of NS/LR?

q_3bdff5fb4e.stem: In post-partum hemorrhage, after the initial oxytocin infusion of up to 500 mL over 10 minutes, at what rate is it continued?

q_8f23e5c807.stem: In post-partum hemorrhage, why must undiluted oxytocin never be injected intravenously?
q_8f23e5c807.explanation: Undiluted IV oxytocin can drop maternal blood pressure sharply in a patient who is already hemorrhaging. If no IV is available, 10 units IM is given instead.

q_e21909b63a.explanation: Methylergonovine is the second-line uterotonic at 0.2 mg IM every 2 to 4 hours, used when oxytocin has not produced adequate contraction; consulting the receiving physician or on-line medical control is also suggested.

q_d55d1ff012.stem: What dressing should be placed over a burn?

q_ac80eb4715.explanation: General Trauma Care is the base guideline that every other trauma guideline assumes has been started, and the crew returns to it for ongoing evaluation and management after any excursion.
